messages.text: I’ll read the integration contract and combined detector sources, then update the assigned geometry and tests for the barrel interfaces and shared services. I’ll leave the TDR, accounting and native verification to the coordinator.

The barrel factory already supports the required subtraction solids. I can add the windows and pipe saddles through an adapter while preserving the standalone control. I also found that the combined validator subtracts full cut volumes, which is invalid for overlapping windows and pipe holes; I’ll replace that calculation with an explicit bounded-volume policy.

The first combined export completed with the redesigned barrel modules, all twelve endcap discs and the replacement shared services. The fan pockets share cells with the longitudinal trunk, and each station joins at its datum plus 100 mm. I’m checking the inventory and independent power, fibre and pipe payloads next.

The export contains the required 46,682 planes and 54 logical groups. The new barrel controls pass, including the central lands’ U-bend cuts and rejection of the old pickup offset. The service generator now compares its partitioned cells with an independent route integral for each material.

All portable checks pass: 14 combined tracker tests and 22 DES043 tests. They cover new and historical exports, service conservation, disjoint cells and walls, cell-grid selection, missing planes and rejection of unproved exact CSG capacities. The implementation is ready for the coordinator to freeze and run native validation.

Implementation is ready to freeze against input revision `2c1bfe02e87f201abcd1e461a554d951bdc7f56e`.
